test_trace_back_orthocenter: test the trace_back module by solving an orthocenter dependency difference problem with ddar
run_ddar_solve: run ddar.solve on a geometry graph with theorems to prove a problem goal
build_graph_from_problem: build a geometry graph from a Problem parsed from text using Graph.build_problem
get_dependency_logs: get setup and auxiliary dependency logs from trace_back.get_logs for a given query and graph
parse_problem_from_txt: parse a geometry problem from a text string using Problem.from_txt to construct a Problem object
